page.title: Support MyPhonicsBooks
page.heading: Everything is free. Support is optional.
page.intro: MyPhonicsBooks is built by one small team. If it helps your child read, a thank-you of any size keeps it free for the next family.

free.books: All 33 storybooks, eight levels — read online, no account needed
free.games: Every phonics game, free to play
free.pdfs: Printable PDFs of every book and worksheet — free with a free account
free.check: The 3-minute phonics check and progress tracking

page.downloadsNote: Downloads need a free account so we can keep the printable PDFs for families and classrooms — they're not for resale.
page.cardSubtitle: Pay what you like · one-off · no subscription
page.alreadySupported: Thank you — you've already supported us.
page.stripeNote: Secure card payment by Stripe. Nothing is unlocked or locked by this — it's a thank-you, not a fee.
page.createBookNote: Looking for a personalised book? <link>Create a Book</link> is £4.99, and the World of Books is a one-off £10.

prompt.title: You're in — everything's free
prompt.body: Every book, game and worksheet is yours at no cost. If MyPhonicsBooks helps your child, you can leave a small thank-you to keep it free for other families. Completely optional.
